citation: Shawnee County Zoning Regulations, Article 39, Sec. 39.05(a)(1)-(24)
note: Short checklist labels for the auto-check. These are pointers to the code sections, not the regulation text.

items.title: North arrow, date, and vicinity map
Boundary dimensions, legal description, written and graphic scale
Drainage arrows, ponds, and a site summary table
Structures with stories, floor area, and entrances
Curb cuts, radii, aisles, parking including accessible stalls, and loading
Screen walls and fences, with height and material
